title: Borrow subtraction preserves length
statement: For every incoming Boolean borrow flag and Boolean word, the output word produced by fixed-width borrow subtraction has the same length as the input word.
hypotheses_covered: The incoming borrow flag is Boolean
The input word is a Boolean word
replaced:
For every incoming borrow flag and word, the word returned by the fixed-width
borrow subtraction has the same length as the input word.
